title: Heathrow Rewards
overview: A full redesign of the Heathrow Rewards loyalty programme — transforming a fragmented airport shopping experience into a seamless, AI-enhanced mobile journey for millions of passengers.

sections.label: Challenge
sections.content: Heathrow's loyalty app was underperforming with low engagement and high churn. Users found it difficult to understand their points, discover offers, and redeem rewards — especially under the time pressure of airport travel.

sections.alt: User research sessions at Heathrow Terminal 5
sections.caption: User research sessions — Terminal 5

sections.label: Research
sections.content: I led end-to-end UX research including contextual inquiry at the airport, diary studies, and 24 moderated usability tests across iOS and Android. Key insight: 78% of users checked their balance only once per visit — the app lacked a meaningful reason to return.

sections.caption: From low-fi flows to high-fidelity prototypes

sections.label: Design
sections.content: Redesigned the core information architecture to surface rewards and offers contextually based on flight time and location. Introduced an AI-powered recommendation layer that personalises offers based on travel history and preferences.
